title: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
summary: Ripple wins final US approval for national trust bank
briefing: The approval clears the way for Ripple to manage reserves backing its RLUSD stablecoin and provide digital asset custody.

title: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
summary: US OCC calls on community banks to become payment stablecoin issuers
briefing: The announcement followed the banking regulator finalizing its rules for the GENIUS Act, a stablecoin law to be implemented in January

title: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
summary: Injective launches onchain futures market tracking Nvidia GPU rental costs
briefing: The new index tracks rental prices for five Nvidia GPUs, offering leveraged trading and potential hedging against fluctuations in AI computing costs.

title: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
summary: Canada opens consultation on stablecoins, citing US GENIUS Act
briefing: As part of the potential implementation of its Stablecoin Act, the Canadian government will hear from the public on a proposed framework for tokens from non-financial institutions.

title: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
summary: AI company Anthropic announces IPO, expected as early as November
briefing: The artificial intelligence company disclosed more than $16 billion in revenue and an $80 billion net loss for the first half of 2026.

title: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
summary: NBA names Kalshi, Polymarket preferred exchanges, signs CFTC deal
briefing: The US professional basketball league is expanding into prediction markets with official data agreements and safeguards against insider trading.

title: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
summary: South Korea lawmakers mull pushing crypto tax implementation to 2029
briefing: The Seoul government is reportedly weighing another delay for a 2020 income tax policy on digital assets, citing concerns with receiving data from US officials.

title: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
summary: Kalshi strikes deal with S&P Dow Jones Indices to expand financial event contracts
briefing: The agreement adds S&P Dow Jones gauges to a growing list of Wall Street firms expanding their involvement in prediction markets.

summary: Canada’s Draft Stablecoin Rules Cap Redemption Fees at 1% and Ban Yield
briefing: Ottawa opened a 60-day consultation on draft rules requiring one-to-one reserves and fast redemption from stablecoin issuers, while keeping the ban on paying holders interest.

title: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Its Half-Good AI Model at Half the Price
summary: OpenAI Launches GPT-6.1 Terra, Its Half-Good AI Model at Half the Price
briefing: OpenAI's mid-tier model now operates apps and screens more like a person would, with API prices 50% below GPT-5.6 Terra and an error rate that OpenAI says fell sharply.

title: Unitree Stock Jumps as Investors Bet Chatbot AI Will Finally Give Robots a Brain
summary: Unitree Stock Jumps as Investors Bet Chatbot AI Will Finally Give Robots a Brain
briefing: Unitree's shares have jumped about 60% in under two weeks as investors bet OpenAI's GPT-6 Astra will give robots the brains they lack, turning the stock into an AI proxy.

summary: NBA Embraces the CFTC on Prediction Markets as the NFL Fights It in Court
briefing: The agreement, which follows similar deals with MLB and NHL, establishes information-sharing to guard against insider trading as sports betting migrates to CFTC-regulated venues.

title: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
summary: South Korea Arrests Seven in First Big AI-Assisted Hacking Case
briefing: Police in Seoul say a 32-year-old with no IT background used AI tools to break into about 90 hospitals, schools and companies, then pressed victims for roughly $270,000 combined.

summary: AI Agents Found a Way Into Anthropic's Business Systems in Under 12 Hours
briefing: Cathedral, a startup founded by ex-DOGE staffers, says its AI agents found paths into Anthropic's sales, HR, and IT systems through third-party software.

title: Why Prediction Markets Got the Brazilian Election So Wrong
summary: Why Prediction Markets Got the Brazilian Election So Wrong
briefing: Experts say Brazil's prediction market ban left the odds in the hands of traders with little knowledge about the election.

title: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
summary: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
briefing: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion chip deal with Apollo while lenders shut the door on smaller AI cloud firms, a split that could decide who controls computing.
